info.name: Jobs API
info.description:
A comprehensive API for user authentication and form management. This API uses JWT-based authentication and provides CRUD operations for forms.

## Authentication
All `/api/v1/form` endpoints require a valid JWT token in the Authorization header:
```
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

## Rate Limiting
- 100 requests per 15 minutes per IP

## Security Features
- Helmet.js for HTTP headers security
- CORS enabled
- XSS protection
- Rate limiting

item.name: Auth
item.description: Authentication endpoints for user registration and login. These endpoints do not require authentication.

request.description:
Register a new user account.

**Request Body:**
- `username` (string, required): Username (1-50 characters)
- `password` (string, required): Password (minimum 4 characters)

**Response:**
- `201 Created`: Returns user object with name and JWT token
- `400 Bad Request`: Validation errors (missing fields, invalid format)
- `409 Conflict`: Username already exists

Authenticate an existing user and receive a JWT token.

**Request Body:**
- `username` (string, required): User's username
- `password` (string, required): User's password

**Response:**
- `200 OK`: Returns user object with name and JWT token
- `400 Bad Request`: Missing username or password
- `401 Unauthorized`: Invalid credentials

item.name: Forms
item.description: Form management endpoints. All endpoints in this folder require JWT authentication via Bearer token in the Authorization header.

request.description:
Retrieve all forms created by the authenticated user, sorted by creation date.

**Authentication:** Required (Bearer token)

**Response:**
- `200 OK`: Returns array of form objects and count
- `401 Unauthorized`: Invalid or missing token

Retrieve a specific form by ID. Only returns forms owned by the authenticated user.

**Authentication:** Required (Bearer token)

**Path Parameters:**
- `id` (string, required): MongoDB ObjectId of the form

**Response:**
- `200 OK`: Returns the form object
- `401 Unauthorized`: Invalid or missing token
- `404 Not Found`: Form not found or not owned by user

Create a new form. The form will be automatically associated with the authenticated user.

**Authentication:** Required (Bearer token)

**Request Body:**
- `username` (string, required): Form username (max 100 characters)
- `password` (string, required): Form password
- `status` (string, optional): Form status - one of: "pending", "approved", "declined" (default: "pending")
- `notes` (string, optional): Additional notes (max 500 characters)
- `role` (string, optional): User role - one of: "admin", "user" (default: "user")

**Response:**
- `201 Created`: Returns the created form object
- `400 Bad Request`: Validation errors
- `401 Unauthorized`: Invalid or missing token

variable.description: MongoDB ObjectId of the form to update

request.description:
Update an existing form. Only forms owned by the authenticated user can be updated.

**Authentication:** Required (Bearer token)

**Path Parameters:**
- `id` (string, required): MongoDB ObjectId of the form

**Request Body (all fields optional):**
- `username` (string): Form username (cannot be empty string)
- `password` (string): Form password (cannot be empty string)
- `status` (string): Form status - one of: "pending", "approved", "declined"
- `notes` (string): Additional notes (max 500 characters)
- `role` (string): User role - one of: "admin", "user"

**Response:**
- `200 OK`: Returns the updated form object
- `400 Bad Request`: Username or password cannot be empty
- `401 Unauthorized`: Invalid or missing token
- `404 Not Found`: Form not found or not owned by user

variable.description: MongoDB ObjectId of the form to delete

request.description:
Delete a form by ID. Only forms owned by the authenticated user can be deleted.

**Authentication:** Required (Bearer token)

**Path Parameters:**
- `id` (string, required): MongoDB ObjectId of the form

**Response:**
- `200 OK`: Returns success message
- `401 Unauthorized`: Invalid or missing token
- `404 Not Found`: Form not found or not owned by user
